title: chore: CI's local-runner step omits two local-runner test suites
description:
Filed by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-30, while planning task-2cf1c6be.

Objective: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the local-runner suites from an explicit `node --test` list (the local-runner step, near line 236). Two suites are missing from it, so CI never runs them:
- scripts/tests/local-runner-vm-control.test.mjs. Its VC rows run only locally. task-d8fc3955's QA noted this as a residual, and task-b8b8faba did not add it.
- scripts/tests/local-runner-daemon-bind.test.mjs, created by task-2cf1c6be. This row dependsOn that task, so the file exists before work starts.

Deliverable: both paths are appended to that step's list. Nothing else in ci.yml changes.

Not in scope:
- any other workflow step;
- any test content;
- other suites missing from CI lists. Name any you find in the completion summary instead.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): first `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build`, because local-runner-channel's C4-C9 rows need a built dist. Then run that CI step's exact `node --test …` line from the repo root. Supply its output to complete_task.
definitionOfDone: .github/workflows/ci.yml's local-runner step lists scripts/tests/local-runner-vm-control.test.mjs and scripts/tests/local-runner-daemon-bind.test.mjs. `grep -c` finds each path exactly once in that file.
`git diff --stat` shows only .github/workflows/ci.yml, with one line changed.
After `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build`, that step's exact `node --test` command, run from the repo root, exits 0. Its output is supplied to complete_task.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Chosen: append both paths to the existing single-line `node --test` list. That is a one-line diff, as DoD 2 requires.
Rejected:
- A separate CI step: DoD says nothing else in ci.yml changes.
- A glob such as scripts/tests/local-runner*.test.mjs: pwsh (Windows default shell) and bash expand it differently, and it silently changes which suites run.
- `if: runner.os` guards: both suites already skip their own platform-specific rows (vm-control VC-L3 and VC-M2 on win32; daemon-bind ::1 rows when ::1 cannot bind). Both pass under Linux node and Windows node today.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:235-236 is step 'Test local runner prerequisite bundles' in job build-all-platforms. That job is a 3-OS matrix (ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest) on Node 24. 'Build daemon' and 'Build proxy' run before it.
- The run: line is one plain YAML scalar listing 8 local-runner suites.
- Before the edit, both new paths have grep -c 0 in ci.yml.
- local-runner-daemon-bind.test.mjs was added in eea1bcaf (task-2cf1c6be WIP). Its fake /health servers listen on loopback and need no built daemon.
- local-runner-vm-control.test.mjs needs no dist.
- local-runner-channel.test.mjs:243 asserts that the built dist/index.js holds the /health bindHost report, so build the daemon first.
- local-runner-bundle.test.mjs fabricates its own dist stubs; no proxy build is needed for local runs.
- No local-runner module imports an npm package.
- ci.yml has LF endings, and .gitattributes enforces eol=lf.
- Epic rail 'All fixes must include regression tests or test updates': this change satisfies it by bringing two existing regression suites into CI. The task scope forbids changing test content.
